campi_del_mandato.environmental_conditions: Pearson correlations declared by the authors on closed periods: pressure -0.44, temperature +0.44, wind -0.59; sump pressure -55 Pa in phase 6
campi_del_mandato.instrument: Radon Scout / Radon Scout Home (SARAD) and AlphaE (Bertin), chamber-checked; passive detectors mostly saturated
campi_del_mandato.licence: arXiv preprint 2403.15392, freely distributed; the journal version is Elsevier
campi_del_mandato.missing_values: Ground floor not tabulated for phase 2; closed phases carry no per-phase concentration, only the pooled averages (54625 basement, 26421 ground floor).
campi_del_mandato.sampling_frequency: Continuous monitoring; the transcription carries per-phase values only - the hourly series exist only as figures
campi_del_mandato.site: Pilot house at Saelices el Chico (Salamanca, Spain), on the former ENUSA uranium site: soil Ra-226 about 1600 Bq/kg, outdoor radon about 300 Bq/m3
campi_del_mandato.soil_properties: Not sampled in this paper: Ra-226 cited from Frutos et al. 2011
campi_del_mandato.split: Exploratory until the project has a two-zone indoor model with depressurisation: nothing in the code can predict these phases today. First candidate for validating the building-entry ring on a real house, as data/INDOOR_CANDIDATI.md records.
campi_del_mandato.timestamp: June 2018 to April 2019, nine testing phases
campi_del_mandato.units: Concentration Bq/m3; extraction velocity m/s; reduction percent
